# `mlangd` manual

```roff
.TH MLANGD 1 "May 2026" "MLang" "User Commands"
.SH NAME
mlangd \- native C++ Language Server Protocol server for MLang
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B mlangd
.B \-\-stdio
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B mlangd
is the native C++ Language Server Protocol server for MLang. It serves editor
features such as diagnostics, hover, definition lookup, references, rename,
semantic tokens, and formatting over standard input and standard output using
JSON-RPC and LSP framing.
.PP
The server is intended to be launched by an editor or client process, not used
interactively in a terminal session.
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.B \-\-stdio
Start the server in stdio mode. This is the only supported runtime mode.
.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B MLANG_LSP_DEBUG
Enable native debug telemetry.
.TP
.B MLANG_LSP_DEBUG_LOG
Write native debug telemetry to the given file path.
.TP
.B MLANGD_COMPILER_CACHE_CLEAR_INTERVAL
Override the semantic/compiler cache clear interval in seconds for long-running
sessions.
.TP
.B MLANGD_FORMATTER
Override the formatter executable used for LSP formatting requests. By
default
.B mlangd
looks for a sibling
.B mlang-format
binary first and then falls back to
.BR PATH .
.TP
.B MLANG_STDLIB_PATH
Override the standard-library module search path used by the tooling layer.
.SH EXAMPLES
.nf
mlangd --stdio
MLANG_LSP_DEBUG=1 mlangd --stdio
MLANG_LSP_DEBUG=1 MLANG_LSP_DEBUG_LOG=/tmp/mlangd.log mlangd --stdio
MLANGD_COMPILER_CACHE_CLEAR_INTERVAL=180 mlangd --stdio
.fi
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR mlang-format (1),
.BR mlangd-mla (1),
.BR mlang (1)
```
